T3_about.h2: What MAGLUMI X8 is and who it is for
T3_about.text: MAGLUMI X8 is a fully automated Snibe CLIA analyzer for chemiluminescence immunoassay in medium and large laboratories. A single module can operate independently, or four modules can be combined for higher testing volumes. SATLARS automation connectivity and the availability of individual assays should be confirmed for the relevant market and laboratory project.

items.text: A laboratory can begin with one module and combine modules as testing volume grows. The exact configuration can be planned for each project.
Disposable tips are designed to reduce cross-contamination, according to the manufacturer. Four independent groups perform magnetic-separation washing.
The interface displays testing progress and reagent and consumable levels in real time. Software can schedule instrument power-on and power-off times.

testMenu.title: MAGLUMI CLIA test menu
testMenu.text: The menu spans hormones, tumor markers, infectious and cardiac markers, and other areas. Ask LabWell to confirm which individual assays are available in Ukraine.

items.q: What is the throughput of MAGLUMI X8?
items.a: A single MAGLUMI X8 module delivers up to 600 tests per hour, while a four-module configuration delivers up to 2,400 tests per hour.

items.q: Which laboratories is MAGLUMI X8 designed for?
items.a: MAGLUMI X8 is designed for medium and large laboratories. Its modular configuration allows the system to be adapted to testing volume.

items.q: How many samples and reagents can be loaded?
items.a: A single module provides 300 sample positions and 42 reagent positions.

items.q: Which tests can MAGLUMI X8 perform?
items.a: The analyzer uses the MAGLUMI CLIA test menu; ask LabWell to confirm which individual assays are available in Ukraine.

items.q: Who supplies MAGLUMI X8 in Ukraine?
items.a: LabWell is a Snibe partner and supplier in Ukraine, providing supply, installation, staff training and service support.
